fm.title: Channel propagation
fm.description: Propagation channel models and interference (3 blocks)

rows.intent: Generate broadband jamming interference — use for modeling electronic warfare scenarios or testing radar performance under intentional interference
Model narrowband two-ray propagation with ground reflection — use for simulating multipath fading in automotive or low-altitude radar scenarios
Model wideband two-ray propagation with ground reflection — use for simulating frequency-selective multipath in wideband radar systems

fm.title: Targets clutter
fm.description: Radar target models and environmental clutter (5 blocks)

rows.intent: Simulate radar backscatter from a moving bicyclist — use for generating realistic micro-Doppler signatures in automotive radar scenarios
Simulate radar backscatter from a walking pedestrian — use for generating realistic micro-Doppler signatures for vulnerable road user detection
Generate surface clutter returns with constant gamma reflectivity — use for simulating ground or sea clutter in radar system performance evaluation
GPU-accelerated surface clutter generation — use for high-fidelity clutter simulation when processing speed is critical in large radar scenarios
Generate synthetic radar detections from scenario objects — use for rapid prototyping of radar processing algorithms without full signal-level simulation

fm.title: Waveforms processing
fm.description: Waveform generation and signal processing (4 blocks)

rows.intent: Cluster radar detections using density-based spatial clustering — use for grouping point detections into distinct objects without knowing object count
Merge detection lists from multiple sensors or frames — use for combining radar detections before tracking or fusion processing
Apply matched filtering to compress radar pulses — use for improving range resolution and SNR in pulsed radar receivers
Generate configurable radar transmit waveforms — use for creating LFM chirps, phase-coded pulses, or custom waveforms for radar transmitters
